comment: Experiment for 0.5.0 (extra_operations: HOVER), written without access to the site: probe before trusting the outcomes. The jQuery UI menu opens its submenu on hover and, as far as I know, on click as well, so both arms of an A/B may pass here; what this spec measures is whether Jev chooses HOVER when it is offered and what offering it does to the other steps. A menu that opens on :hover only (most site navigation bars) is the case HOVER exists for: add one from an application of your own.
goal: Open the Enabled menu by hovering over it and choose 'Back to JQuery UI' from the submenu it opens, so that the JQuery UI page is shown.
notes: The submenu appears only while the pointer is over Enabled.

back_on_jquery_ui.when: The page heading says 'JQuery UI'. The page explains that JQuery UI Menus are tricky to automate.
